steps.text: Talk to the Wanderer west of the Agility Pyramid.

items.name: Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it

choices: Why? What's your problem with it?

steps.text: Talk to the Wanderer again with the required items.

items.name: Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it

choices: Yes. I have them all here.

steps.text: Enter the rock west of the Agility Pyramid to re-enter Sophanem.
Enter the pyramid in the south of Sophanem.
Follow the path until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Attempt to open the western door.
Solve the door puzzle.
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem with your cat, and answer its riddle with '9.'.
Talk to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem.
Talk to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem.
Enter the pyramid in the south of Sophanem.
Follow the path again until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Attempt to pick up the Crondis Canopic Jar, and kill Apparition (level 75) when they appear. They will attack with magic.
Attempt to pick up the Scarabas Canopic Jar, and kill Apparition (level 75) when they appear. They will attack with melee.
Attempt to pick up the Apmeken Canopic Jar, and kill Apparition (level 75) when they appear. They will attack with magic.
Attempt to pick up the Het Canopic Jar, and kill Apparition (level 81) when they appear. They will attack with melee.
Try picking up the canopic jars in the north west room until a level 75-81 enemy spawns. Kill them. You can safespot them on the central table.
Pick up the Crondis Canopic Jar.
Pick up the Scarabas Canopic Jar.
Pick up the Apmeken Canopic Jar.
Pick up the Het Canopic Jar.
Try picking up the canopic jars in the north west room again.
Jump back over the pit with the jar.
Jump back over to the north side of the pit. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps inside the pyramid.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Solve the door puzzle again.
Leave the pyramid and return to the High Priest.
Return to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem.
Talk to the Embalmer just south of the High Priest.

items.name: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

steps.text: Talk to the Embalmer again just south of the High Priest.

items.name: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

steps.text: Fill up a bucket with salt water from the lake north of Sophanem, or buy a bag of salt from a Slayer Master.
Use the bucket of saltwater on the suntrap in the south east of Sophenam.
Talk to the Carpenter in the east of Sophanem until he gives you the holy symbol.
choices: Alright, I'll get the wood for you.

steps.text: Talk to the Carpenter again in the east of Sophanem.
Talk to the Carpenter again in the east of Sophanem once more.
Get some linen. You can buy some from Raetul in east Sophanem for 30 coins.
Enter the rock west of the Agility Pyramid to re-enter Sophanem. Make sure to bring the items you need.

items.name: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

steps.text: Enter the pyramid in the south of Sophanem.
Follow the path again until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Enter the east room.
Use the unholy symbol on a sarcophagus.
Leave the east room.
Jump over the pit.
Enter the east room again.
Kill the possessed priest. Pray protect from magic against the priest.
Talk to the High Priest in the north east room of the pyramid.
Open the door of the pyramid in the south of Sophanem to watch a cutscene.
Leave the pyramid and witness a cutscene at the exit.
Return to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem to finish the quest.
